purpose: Register, before any arm is trained, the token-conditioned correction gate and the three supervision weights (KL-disagreement, signed teacher advantage, both), with the decision rule that picks one for the next route. This amends the corrective-graft mechanism registered at S42; the S42 file is not edited.

amends.note: the S42 mechanism is superseded in the gate parameterisation and adds the signed-advantage comparison; its 2M token budget, teacher, stream and evaluation are unchanged

relation_to_existing_registrations.s42_corrective: the S42 corrective graft used a global scalar gate alpha(site) = tanh(gate_raw) and a KL-disagreement weight. This file replaces the scalar with a token-conditioned gate and registers the signed-advantage comparison.
relation_to_existing_registrations.full_bar: docs/ws19-full-distillation-preregistration-v1.json remains the 20M bar; no verdict about it is drawn from 2M numbers
relation_to_existing_registrations.math_stream_amendment: docs/ws19-full-distillation-amendment-math-stream-preregistration-v1.json replaces the general-only stream for the full arm; the 2M corrective arms stay on the registered 2M stream so they remain comparable to the existing 2M receipts

mechanism.feature_map: phi(h_t, r_t) = [h_t ; r_t], a parameter-free concatenation of the site's hidden state and the memory read
mechanism.initialisation: w = 0 and b = 0 exactly, so alpha_t = 0 for every token and the untrained model is the base bit for bit; no zero multiplicand is used, so dL/dalpha is non-zero at zero

active_parameter_cost.basis: the read, key projection, value projection, convolution and table are the S40/S42 memory construction; only the gate's parameterisation changes

mechanism.why_token_conditioned: a scalar gate must make the same correction everywhere; the measured harm of the representation graft was largest where the base was already correct, and the held-out distribution mixes positions where the base matches the teacher with positions where it does not. A per-token gate can be open on the latter and closed on the former; the preservation penalty is the training-time incentive, the gate is the capacity.

supervision.teacher: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B-Base at b1485b2fa6dfa1287294f269f5fb618e03d52d7c, online, no logit cache

kl_disagreement_weight.form: KL(teacher_T || base_T) at position t, detached

signed_teacher_advantage.form: log p_T(y_t) - log p_B(y_t) on the supervised target, at T = 1.0, detached
signed_teacher_advantage.sign: positive where the teacher assigns more probability than the base to the true next token; negative where the base is already better

both.form: u_t = sqrt(u_kl,t * u_signed,t) renormalised to mean 1
both.why: the geometric mean keeps a position high only if both the disagreement and the signed advantage are high, instead of letting one unbounded quantity dominate

supervision.preservation_weight: p_t = sigmoid(-(a_t - mean a)/mean a), high where the base already matches the teacher

harm_measurement.requirement: the preservation penalty is not accepted on the mean alone; harm is reported separately on the tokens the base already handles

masks.lowest_quartile: a_t <= the 25th percentile of a_t over the batch, the P19.8 interference-cost definition
masks.signed_base_better: A_t >= 0, i.e. the teacher assigns no more probability to the true token than the base

quantities: number of tokens in the mask
mean delta KL = mean(KL_student - KL_base) on the mask
fraction of mask tokens where the student is worse than the base
harm_measurement.reading: a positive mean delta and a fraction worse above zero is the harm the preservation term exists to prevent; it must be reported even when the mean CE improves

corrective-gate-kl.role: the token gate under the S42 supervision signal; the like-for-like comparison to the scalar-gate arm

corrective-gate-signed.role: the signed teacher advantage replaces the KL-disagreement weight

corrective-cekl-2m.role: the objective control from the S42 registration, unchanged and re-stated here

gate-zero-control.role: parity control for the new gate parameterisation

common.optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-3, betas 0.9/0.95, constant, warmup 50, clip 1.0

decision_rule: 1. If signed or both beats kl on held-out CE by more than the combined standard error and does not lose KL beyond its standard error, adopt that weighting and carry the token-gated corrective arm to the 20M bar comparison.
2. If CE ties within the combined standard error and signed or both lowers the harm on the base-match masks by more than its standard error, adopt that weighting and record the CE tie.

3. If signed and both lose CE to kl beyond the combined standard error, keep the KL-disagreement weighting and record that the signed advantage is too noisy at 2M; the next route is a registered gate-feature change (phi adds the base advantage scalar) or no gate conditioning, not an unregistered retune.
4. If every corrective arm loses to base on CE, the 2M mechanism screen is a null; the next route is the 20M full-arm bar and then P19.4, not another 2M variant.

next_route.if_a_weighting_wins: score the winning arm on the anchored harness beside the 20M full arm; only a gain over the full arm at equal tokens and equal deployed active union is a mechanism win
next_route.if_kl_wins: the gate is still the S43 mechanism; the supervision stays KL and the next objective question is a registered feature-map change
next_route.if_all_lose: the 2M screen is a null for the corrective family; register no further 2M objective variant before the 20M bar

heldout.metrics: mean next-token CE and mean KL(teacher_T || student_T) at T=2.0, standard errors across non-overlapping 512-token chunks, paired per-chunk against base and against each other
heldout.harm: the two masks above, with paired per-chunk deltas

anchored_harness.driver: scripts/s40_score.py; a total-capped run must use scripts/s43_score_total_cap.py
anchored_harness.verdict_policy: no verdict on the mechanism against the 20M bar from 2M numbers

files: oracle/tests/test_s42_corrective.py (updated to the token gate; 20 tests pass with the new file)
claims: zero-init bit-identity with grafted rows and a non-zero offset
the gate is zero at init and varies per token once w is non-zero; identical (h, r) gives identical alpha
the signed advantage is positive when the teacher is better on the target and negative when the base is
gradient reaches rows, key and value projections once the gate is open, and the path is deterministic for a fixed seed
the signed and both weights order positions by the signed advantage
harm is reported on the lowest-advantage quartile and the signed base-better set
the active union is the memory union plus 2*hidden+1 per site

what_this_file_does_not_establish: that the token gate beats the scalar gate: that is the experiment; the scalar gate has not been trained either
that the signed advantage is better than KL: it is a registered alternative with a decision rule
that 2M tokens transfer to 20M: no verdict about the bar is drawn from 2M numbers
that the gate feature map [h ; r] is optimal: it is the registered first map, chosen for a 2,049-element cost per site
